narrative.overview:
Every answer a parent comes for sits in its own white compartment on a cool grey tray: the next game, the latest result, what is coming up, who leads, and where the team ranks. The tray (#eef0f3 ground) does the separating, so tiles need no borders, no shadows and no rules between them. The result reads like a clean, standard sports website: dense enough to scan a table in one glance, calm enough that the single orange tile is the first thing the eye lands on.

The system is Operate mode. The user chose it on the decision page from a safer-register round (card "Bento", kind grounded, seed `seed:a13390fd4c110ecb`), and the decision comp at `.impeccable/mocks/decision/grounded-bento.png` is the reference composition. It replaces the earlier warm paper world with court-line header bands and 12–16px corners; none of that survives. Personality lives in small details: the drawn follow star, the whole-row warm tint for your team, tight Inter Tight headlines and tabular numbers. The site declines themed costumes: no scoreboards, no programmes, no broadcast graphics, no photography.

The build departs from the comp in one known, reported place: a muted meta line (location · organizer · season dates) sits under the league title row. It stays.
keyCharacteristics: Cool grey ground, white borderless tiles with 18px corners, 14px gutters between tiles.
One Shotclock-orange tile per page, carrying near-black ink text, for the next game.
Near-black ink for headings, data and primary actions; muted grey for labels and secondary links.
Your followed team is marked by a warm whole-row tint plus a drawn star, everywhere it appears.
Flat at rest; the only shadow is the directory league tile on hover.
Tabular numerals in every score, record, time and stat.

rules.name: The One Orange Tile Rule
rules.body: Each page carries at most one orange-filled tile, and it holds the next game: the division's or your team's on the season overview, and on the directory only when a followed team plays this week. Its text is ink. If a second element wants orange fill, it is wrong.

rules.name: The Ember Ink Restraint Rule
rules.body: Ember Ink is for the follow star, the sort indicator, in-body links and focus. Tile header links ("Schedule", "Full table", "All results") are muted and turn ink with an underline on hover.

rules.name: The Never Colour Alone Rule
rules.body: Every followed-team highlight pairs the Follow Blush tint with the drawn star and its "Followed team" label. Tint without the star is a defect.

rules.name: The Tabular Numbers Rule
rules.body: Scores, records, times, ranks and stats always use tabular numerals; tables get them by default.

rules.name: The Quiet Label Rule
rules.body: A tile is named by a small muted sentence-case heading at its top-left. Uppercase tracking belongs to table column headers and nowhere else.

rules.name: The Flat Tray Rule
rules.body: Tiles are separated by the ground showing through, never by borders or shadows. The league tile hover lift is the single exception.

dos: **Do** put every content group in a white 18px tile on the #eef0f3 ground, separated by 14px gaps.
**Do** give each page at most one orange tile, for the next game, with ink text.
**Do** mark a followed team with the whole-row Follow Blush tint and the drawn star together.
**Do** use ink buttons for Search and every primary action, and the ink pill on a white track for segmented tabs.
**Do** keep tile header links muted, turning ink with an underline on hover.
**Do** keep mini-tiles (#f5f6f8, 12px) for stats nested inside a tile.
**Do** set every score, record, time and stat in tabular numerals.
**Do** let wide tables scroll inside their tile with a right-edge fade; the page itself never scrolls sideways.
donts: **Don't** use photos or any imagery standing in for photos.
**Don't** draw court lines, court markings or any basketball-themed decoration.
**Don't** use Unicode glyphs or emoji as icons; icons are drawn SVG.
**Don't** put eyebrows or kickers above headings; a tile is named by its Label heading alone.
**Don't** add borders around tiles or shadows anywhere other than the directory league tile hover.
**Don't** use Ember Ink for tile links, decoration or headings.
**Don't** signal a followed team by colour alone.
